cells.name: short-cream
cells.strategy: standalone transparent generation and bounded correction; technical alpha slicing only
cells.placement_rule: Mount by measured rodEndpoints with uniform scale, left-wall sloping rod. footAnchor records hem baseline only. Short model keeps its shorter physical silhouette at same rod width. Recheck panels against plant alpha, never stretch.
deviations: Native rod span about 650px below preferred 800px for a 400px slot at 2x; real file dimensions recorded.
Fabric microtexture finer than some approved pixel clusters; room-scale visual acceptance pending.
